mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 3.5%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, where the economy is neither too hot nor too cold, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% month-over-month increase in INDPRO, signaling a surge in industrial production, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances with > 2% INDPRO MoM growth, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising RSAFS (indicating increased retail sales) and low UNRATE (< 4%) boosts consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with rising RSAFS and low UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL over two consecutive months, indicating reduced inflationary pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate more accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with declining CPIAUCSL, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between high PAYEMS (> 150,000) and rising UNRATE (> 0.5% MoM) signals an overheating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of 'overheating' labor market instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% year-over-year increase in HOUST, signaling a strong housing market, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with > 5% HOUST YoY growth, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.
